remarks: Welcome home to New York elegance in our sophisticated 885 Square Foot One Bedroom upper level unit at Hayes House. Large, rectangular Living Room with an expanse of windows overlooking a large, tiled, exterior Balcony with great views of Long Island Sound; Spacious Dining Area, Incredible Kitchen with Stainless appliances, loads of custom cabinetry. Large Bedroom with enormous Walk-in-Closet. Fabulous all Tiled Bathroom with over-sized Shower. Three additional good sized closets. Unit includes: Heat/Hot Water, Central AC; One Indoor Reserved Garage Space. Additional Indoor spaces available at a monthly rental fee. Fabulous Health & Fitness Center ($15.00 a month/per person). Rear Deck with tables/chairs/umbrellas & BBQ's (No BBQ's permitted on individual Balconies). 24/7 Front Desk Door personnel. Shared Laundry on C Level. Great Community Room available for gatherings. Close to great restaurants, movie theaters, library, parks. Seven minutes to I-95 and the Stamford RR Station. Move-in/Move-out fee ($175 + $150--the latter is returned if no move in/out damages) Good Credit a Must!
